title.narrative: SKILLS FOR YOUTH RESILIENCE PROGRAMME (SYRP) IN MOZAMBIQUE AND ZIMBABWE

description.narrative: This project will focus on: Skills for Economic Resilience – the main activities will include a Scholarship Programme; a Microcredit Programme; Improving Post Graduate Supports; and Supporting Outreach Training to rural communities. Skills for Emotional Resilience through mainstreaming of holistic Life Skills training that provides young people with essential core skills and supporting Young Africa’s Life Skills HR capacity. Organisational Resilience including Capacity building, HR support, targeted support to the Franchise Model and oversight to improve Young Africa's organisational resilience. The project will address critical problems for youth in both countries, namely high unemployment rates exacerbated by low levels of education and lack of technical capacity. It will build on previous programmes funded by the Department and is coherent with the commitment in ‘A Better World’ to support interventions in education and with the priority area of Gender Equality
